metadata.description: Complete GraphRAG knowledge tree of the InfoGeometry toolchain: Lean kernel extraction → DAG artifacts → Python normalization → audit tools → reports. Every file that participates in the inspection/audit/quality pipeline is represented as a node with data-flow edges.

communities.title: Lean DAG Core — Graph Types & Extraction Primitives
communities.description: The foundational Lean modules that define graph data structures, walk expression trees to collect constant dependencies, and build the raw declaration graph from the Lean environment.

communities.title: Lean DAG Indexer — Main Extraction Engine
communities.description: The central DAG/Indexer.lean module that imports the full Lean environment, iterates every constant, extracts metadata (name, kind, module, file, line, doc, attrs, fingerprints), computes dependency edges from type and value expressions, recognizes category-theoretic morphisms, and writes decls.jsonl, edges.jsonl, full_graph.json, meta.json, morphisms.jsonl, types.jsonl, and edge-leakage.json.

communities.title: Lean DAG Export Modules
communities.description: Modules that export different views of the declaration graph: legacy inventory (ExportDecls), process-flow classification (ProcessFlowExport), structural topology (StructuralExport), representation depth tags (RepresentationDepthExport), InfoTree extraction, expression fingerprinting, ArangoDB export, and various audit/analysis modules.

communities.title: Lean DAG Audit Modules
communities.description: Lean-native audit modules that detect disconnected capstones, proofless declarations, exact morphisms, category bridges, and integration tests. These run inside the Lean environment and produce structured audit JSON.

communities.title: Lean DAG Mathematical Modules
communities.description: Modules that contain actual mathematical content used as kernel-checked theorems in the DAG infrastructure: chiral Dirac anticommutation, affine projective closure, Hodge theorems, harmonic KMS, Connes-Hodge bridge, algebraic exponential, graded Bott periodicity, matrix representation, and higher category theory (two-complex, triple system).

communities.title: Lean Meta Attributes & Policies
communities.description: The attribute system that tags declarations with architectural metadata: @[rep_depth] (6-layer depth grammar), @[capstone] (composite exemption), @[infrastructure]/@[terminal]/@[expository] (vacuity roles), plus owner/bridge/socket target interfaces, strict definition/surface policies, shadow ledger, trust policy, honesty policy, and formal logos.

communities.title: Lean Lint — Biopsy & Surgery Contracts
communities.description: Lint modules that perform deep inspection of Lean declarations: NonTriviality (expression-tree vacuity audit, transitive axiom scan, genuineness classification), Pauli (legacy triviality wrapper), Vacuity (vacuity role detection), WitnessLint (witness completeness), SurgeryContract (refactoring safety contracts).

communities.title: Python Orchestration Layer
communities.description: Python scripts that drive the Lean extraction tools. They manage the locked prebuild, run the DAG Indexer, stamp metadata with olean hashes for incremental skip, and extract blueprint tags from the Lean environment.

communities.title: LeanTrail Backend — Normalization & Storage
communities.description: The Python backend that reads all DAG artifacts and produces the canonical GraphSnapshot with NodeRecords and EdgeRecords, then builds the in-memory GraphStore with BFS search, path finding, holonomy scoring, coherence hotspot detection, and dedup candidate identification.

communities.title: LeanTrail API Server
communities.description: HTTP API server exposing the query surface: search, decl lookup, neighborhood, shortest path, proof state, coherence hotspots, holonomy hotspots, and bridge candidate creation. Auto-rebuilds stale snapshots.

communities.title: LeanTrail Audit Tools
communities.description: Python audit tools that consume the GraphSnapshot and DAG artifacts to perform vacuity detection (runs #biopsy_non_triviality in actual Lean), hole packet ranking (failure→hole pipeline), shadow scanning (text-level sorry/vacuity grep), graph surgery planning (networkx), cross-format conformance checking, and LLM critic prompt generation.

communities.title: LeanTrail CLI Entry Points
communities.description: Thin CLI wrappers (scripts/) that delegate to the tools/leantrail modules.

communities.title: DAG Artifacts — Intermediate Data Files
communities.description: JSON/JSONL files produced by the Lean DAG extraction and consumed by the Python normalization layer. These are the data bridge between the Lean kernel and the Python toolchain.

nodes.title: DAG/Basic.lean
nodes.description: Core graph types (Graph α, HydratedGraph α, EdgeKind type|value) and expression-tree constant extraction primitives (collectExprConsts, edgesFromConstantInfo, projHeads, buildGraphFromEnv). This is the atomic foundation — every other extraction module depends on it.

nodes.title: DAG/Hydrate.lean
nodes.description: Takes a raw Graph α and computes the full SCC/DAG structure: Tarjan SCC → sccOf mapping → DAG condensation → topological order → dominator tree. Produces HydratedGraph α with sccs, sccOf, dag, preds, topo, doms fields.

nodes.title: DAG/SCC.lean
nodes.description: Tarjan's strongly connected components algorithm operating on the forward adjacency representation used by Graph α.

nodes.title: DAG/Topo.lean
nodes.description: Topological sort on the condensed DAG produced by SCC condensation.

nodes.title: DAG/Dominators.lean
nodes.description: Dominator tree computation on the condensed DAG. Used by Hydrate to compute doms field.

nodes.title: DAG/ExprFingerprint.lean
nodes.description: Computes content-addressable SHA256 hashes of Lean expressions (type and value). Used by Indexer to detect duplicate theorems, unchanged proof bodies, and structural dedup candidates.

nodes.title: DAG/JsonInstances.lean
nodes.description: ToJson/FromJson instances for DAG types (EdgeKind, Graph, HydratedGraph).

nodes.title: DAG/Util.lean
nodes.description: Utility functions used across the DAG modules.

nodes.title: DAG/DeclIndex.lean
nodes.description: Declaration index utilities for mapping names to indices and building efficient lookup structures.

nodes.title: DAG/Indexer.lean — Main Extraction Engine
nodes.description: THE central extraction engine. Run via `lake env lean --run lean/DAG/Indexer.lean <import-module> <namespace> <output-dir> <graph-out> <structure-out>`. Iterates every constant in the imported environment, extracts name/kind/module/file/line/doc/attrs/fingerprints, computes dependency edges from ci.type and ci.value? via collectConsts, recognizes category-theoretic morphisms (Func/Hom/Equiv/Iso/Map), writes decls.jsonl, edges.jsonl, full_graph.json, meta.json, morphisms.jsonl, types.jsonl, edge-leakage.json. Maintains edgeSet for deduplication. Uses atomic file writes.

nodes.title: DAG/ProcessFlowExport.lean
nodes.description: Classifies every dependency edge with semantic roles: DependencyRole (head/requiredArg/transportArg/witness/closureSupport/ornament/remoteSupport/unknown), BoundaryClass (internal/localInterface/bridge/capstone/mixed/unclear), LocalityClass (local/adjacent/remote/mixed), PolarityClass, DerivationalRole, DefectKind. Outputs artifacts/dag/process-flow/process-events.jsonl.

nodes.title: DAG/StructuralExport.lean
nodes.description: Exports SCC membership, component IDs, dominator summaries, and canonical root witness paths from the hydrated graph. Produces structural-topology.json.

nodes.title: DAG/ExportDecls.lean — Legacy Inventory Exporter
nodes.description: Legacy declaration inventory exporter. Run via `lake env lean --run lean/DAG/ExportDecls.lean <import-module> <namespace> <output.json> [deps-prefix]`. Filters declarations by namespace, extracts name/kind/module/deps/doc/type, writes JSON. The newer Indexer.lean supersedes this with richer metadata.

nodes.title: DAG/Algo/Traversal.lean
nodes.description: Graph traversal algorithms for the DAG.

nodes.title: InfoGeometry/Meta/Architecture.lean
nodes.description: THE architecture grammar. Defines @[rep_depth count|projective|operator|krein|transport|thermo] (6-layer L0-L5 depth), @[capstone] (composite exemption), nearestTaggedDescendants (BFS through untagged nodes), taggedDependencyViolations (REGRESSION/WORMHOLE detection), #audit_architecture command, #audit_rep_depth_coverage command. Enforces that canonical spine declarations obey depth adjacency.

nodes.title: InfoGeometry/Meta/Vacuity.lean
nodes.description: Lightweight semantic role tags: @[infrastructure] (support lemma, not theorem content), @[terminal] (no downstream reuse), @[expository] (reader-facing wrapper). Used by the Indexer to tag declarations in decls.jsonl.

nodes.title: InfoGeometry/Meta/OwnerTarget.lean
nodes.description: Owner target interface — declares what a module owns and what its completion conditions are.

nodes.title: InfoGeometry/Meta/BridgeTarget.lean
nodes.description: Bridge target interface — declares bridge obligations between owner modules.

nodes.title: InfoGeometry/Meta/SocketTarget.lean
nodes.description: Socket target interface — declares socket/placeholder obligations.

nodes.title: InfoGeometry/Lint/NonTriviality.lean — The Biopsy Gate
nodes.description: THE vacuity detector. Runs inside the Lean kernel. Key components: (1) auditExprTrivialityDetailed — recursive expression-tree walker that classifies every constant as genuine/vacuous/contaminated, with configurable depth, project roots, allowed axioms, and sorry policy. (2) auditTransitiveDependencies — collects all axioms in transitive closure via Lean.collectAxioms, detects sorryAx, forbidden axioms, opaque boundaries. (3) biopsyDeclJson — produces structured JSON with vacuity role (gate/fake_transport/pure_conductor/contaminated/closure_debt/type_boundary), term_node_count, uses_external_gate, contains_vacuous_sockets, hit_unfold_limit, contains_sorry, contamination state, unfolded_local_consts, suspicious_consts. (4) #biopsy_non_triviality command for CLI use. (5) isGenuine criterion: termNodeCount > 5 ∧ utilizesMathlibAxioms ∧ ¬containsVacuousSockets ∧ ¬hitUnfoldLimit ∧ ¬containsSorry.

nodes.title: InfoGeometry/Lint/Pauli.lean
nodes.description: Legacy compatibility wrapper for the old NonTriviality gate. Provides auditExprTriviality for Pauli.lean compatibility.

nodes.title: InfoGeometry/Lint/Vacuity.lean
nodes.description: Vacuity role detection linter — identifies declarations that should carry @[infrastructure]/@[terminal]/@[expository] tags.

nodes.title: InfoGeometry/Lint/WitnessLint.lean
nodes.description: Witness completeness linter — checks that existential statements have explicit witnesses.

nodes.title: InfoGeometry/Lint/SurgeryContract.lean
nodes.description: Surgery contract — defines safety conditions for automated refactoring of Lean declarations.

nodes.title: tools/infra/refresh_decl_graph.py
nodes.description: Full DAG refresh cycle orchestrator. (1) Computes olean content hash + lean source hash for incremental skip. (2) Checks meta.json staleness — skips if unchanged. (3) If stale files detected, forces refresh. (4) Runs locked prebuild. (5) Spawns `lake env lean --run DAG/Indexer.lean`. (6) Stamps meta.json with timestamp + olean hash + source hash. (7) Writes indexer timing sidecar.

nodes.title: tools/infra/refresh_blueprint_tags.py
nodes.description: Extracts @[rep_depth ...] and @[capstone] attribute data into artifacts/dag/representation-depth-tags.json. Consumed by the LeanTrail normalizer to annotate nodes with rep_depth, depth_nat, and capstone flag.

nodes.title: tools/infra/run_locked_lake_build.py
nodes.description: Prebuilds a Lake target under a file lock to prevent concurrent build corruption. Supports exe (compiled executable) and run (interpreted) modes.

nodes.title: tools/infra/artifacts.py
nodes.description: Artifact path utilities: normalize_repo_output, should_skip_decl_refresh, load_decl_index_meta, stamp_decl_index_meta, find_missing_decl_source_files.

nodes.title: tools/infra/build.py
nodes.description: Build utilities: build_indexer_command (constructs the lake env lean command), compute_olean_content_hash (SHA256 of all .olean files), compute_lean_source_hash (SHA256 of all .lean files).

nodes.title: tools/infra/timings.py
nodes.description: Indexer timing sidecar — writes indexer-timing.json with elapsed times from meta.json.

nodes.title: tools/infra/decl_graph.py
nodes.description: Declaration graph Python data structures for the DAG refresh pipeline.

nodes.title: tools/infra/decl_graph_support.py
nodes.description: Graph utility functions for the declaration graph pipeline.

nodes.title: leantrail/backend/models.py
nodes.description: Core dataclasses: NodeRecord (id, name, kind, module, file, line, rep_depth, role, module_family, commit_sha, toolchain, artifact_version, attrs), EdgeRecord (src, dst, kind, weight, evidence_ref, attrs), GraphSnapshot (metadata, nodes, edges) with from_dict/to_dict serialization.

nodes.title: leantrail/backend/normalizer.py
nodes.description: THE normalization engine. Reads all DAG artifacts (decls.jsonl, edges.jsonl, meta.json, representation-depth-tags.json, process-events.jsonl, holonomy-events.jsonl, failed_transitions.jsonl, path_locks.jsonl) and produces canonical GraphSnapshot. Key operations: edge kind mapping (type→depends_type 1.0, value→depends_value 1.1, supportCandidates→translator_of 0.6, comparisonCandidates→coheres_with 0.6, closureDeps→obstructs 0.6), depth violation detection (creates violates_depth edge weight 3.0 when src_depth illegal), role inference fallback, path state annotation (locked/failed/bound/meta), endpoint annotation (source/sink/internal/isolated), edge deduplication merging evidence_refs.

nodes.title: leantrail/backend/store.py
nodes.description: In-memory graph database built from GraphSnapshot. node_by_id: dict, out_edges/in_edges adjacency lists. Operations: search (substring scan), get_decl (hash lookup + edges), neighborhood (BFS with radius and limit), shortest_path_with_state_policy (BFS with edge filtering — blocks violates_depth/obstructs when lawful, filters by state_policy: any|exclude-failed|locked-only), coherence_hotspots (score = 2·translator + 5·violation + 0.05·dep), holonomy_hotspots (score = α·tactic_steps + β·context_expansion + γ·metavariable_flux, telemetry or proxy), dedup_candidates (reads attrs.structural_dedup).

nodes.title: leantrail/backend/query_api.py
nodes.description: Query API wrapping GraphStore with snapshot staleness detection (compares commit_sha + dag_meta fields), auto-rebuild on stale, proof-state RPC via LeanRPCAdapter, bridge candidate creation with JSON schema validation. Methods: search, dedup_candidates, decl, neighborhood, path, proofstate, coherence_hotspots, holonomy_hotspots, create_bridge_candidate.

nodes.title: leantrail/backend/indexer.py
nodes.description: Python-side snapshot builder. Calls normalizer.build_snapshot() and writes the result. Supports incremental mode: detects changed modules from git diff, expands to impacted neighborhood, rebuilds only those modules, merges patch into existing snapshot. CI policy: full rebuilds for deterministic artifact completeness.

nodes.title: leantrail/backend/extractor.py
nodes.description: Subprocess runner for DAG refresh commands. Executes the 4-step pipeline: run_locked_lake_build → refresh_decl_graph → refresh_blueprint_tags → ProcessFlowExport.

nodes.title: leantrail/backend/rpc_adapter.py
nodes.description: Adapts the Lean RPC protocol for proof-state queries. Wraps lake env lean invocations for live interaction with the Lean environment. Used by the /proofstate API endpoint.

nodes.title: leantrail/api/server.py
nodes.description: HTTP API server exposing the full query surface: GET /search?q=, GET /decl/{name}, GET /neighborhood/{name}?radius=2, GET /path?from=&to=&lawful_only=&state_policy=, GET /proofstate?file=&line=&col=, GET /coherence/hotspots, GET /holonomy/hotspots, POST /bridge-candidate. Auto-loads/rebuilds snapshot on first request.

nodes.title: leantrail/backend/app.py
nodes.description: Application factory for the LeanTrail server.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/vacuity_audit.py
nodes.description: THE biopsy gate driver. Reads declarations from snapshot, generates temporary .lean files with `#biopsy_non_triviality <decl>` commands, runs `lake env lean` on each batch, parses JSON output from the NonTriviality biopsy, classifies each declaration by vacuity_role. Supports --module-prefix, --decl-prefix, --decl, --limit, --module-batch-size, --timeout, --keep-going. Outputs vacuity_audit.jsonl.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/vacuity_ingest.py
nodes.description: Ingests vacuity audit results into the snapshot/LEDger for downstream analysis.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/hole_packets.py
nodes.description: Failure-to-hole pipeline. Groups failed transitions by (src, dst), computes priority score (total_cost + 2·failure_count + 3·diversity of error_kinds), Z2 surrogate (odd=open, even=pairable), annotates path states (any, exclude-failed, locked-only), annotates required lock status from conformance report, attaches socratic packet template. Outputs hole_packets.jsonl + hole_packets.md.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/shadow_index.py
nodes.description: Text-level shadow debt scanner. No compilation — pure regex. Detects: sorryDebt (\bsorry\b), vacuityDebt (field names ending in _True/_sorryProof/_certificate/_witness/_bridge etc. with Prop), wrapperDebt (structure with certificate fields in next 10 lines), failedCompilation (optional slow lake build check). Has domain detection via keyword matching (Berezinian, Pfaffian, BottPeriodicity, CliffordAlgebra, HodgeKrein, etc.). Outputs shadow_manifest.json + ShadowReport.md.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/shadow_ledger.py
nodes.description: Tracks avoidance and resolution of shadow debt items across time. Maintains a ledger of when each debt item was first detected, last checked, and whether it was resolved or suppressed.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/surgery_plan.py
nodes.description: Graph surgery planner using networkx. Builds nx.DiGraph from snapshot, identifies vacuum roles (fake_transport, pure_conductor) for contraction, computes SCC decomposition, identifies removable subgraphs, plans node removal/merge operations. Requires networkx.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/surgery_apply.py
nodes.description: Applies a surgery plan — executes the planned node removals/merges on the actual Lean source files.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/conformance.py
nodes.description: Cross-format parity check. Compares two graph representations (snapshot, graphml, neo4j-csv, arango-json). Checks: node/edge count drift percentages, node/edge kind distribution comparison, overlap on node ids and edge keys, dependency SCC signature parity, shortest-path query parity on canonical seeds, hotspot overlap (coherence, holonomy) via Jaccard index, required-path-lock gate (fails if locked paths missing from candidate).

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/critic_packets.py
nodes.description: Generates LLM critic prompt packets from vacuity/hole data for socratic review.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/critic_prompt_builder.py
nodes.description: Builds structured LLM prompts from vacuity audit and hole packet data for external AI review.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/critic_ingest.py
nodes.description: Ingests critic review results back into the audit pipeline.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/dedup_candidates.py
nodes.description: Identifies structural deduplication candidates — declarations that may be aliases of each other based on expression fingerprint matching.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/failure_harvester.py
nodes.description: Harvests process-flow defects into failed_transitions.jsonl. Consumes artifacts/dag/process-flow/defects.jsonl and optional build logs (--build-log, --build-stdout, --build-stderr). Called automatically by scripts/quality/strict-check.sh on strict failure.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/path_lock_registry.py
nodes.description: Registers bound or locked path records. Locked paths survive conformance gates — they represent known-correct dependency chains that must not be broken. Supports state: locked|bound, state-policy: exclude-failed, proof-ref for provenance.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/export.py
nodes.description: Exports canonical snapshot to external formats: GraphML (graph_snapshot.graphml), Neo4j CSV (neo4j/nodes.csv, edges.csv, metadata.json), Arango JSON (arango/ig_nodes.jsonl, ig_edges.jsonl, metadata.json). Supports --to all|graphml|neo4j|arango.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/adapters.py
nodes.description: Format adapters: import_graphml, import_neo4j_csv, import_arango_json — convert external graph formats into GraphSnapshot. Used by conformance.py and export.py.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/arango_ingest.py
nodes.description: Loads LeanTrail snapshot or adapter output into ArangoDB for graph database querying.

nodes.title: tools/leantrail/arango_physics_evaluator.py
nodes.description: Local surprisal evaluation along dependency paths. Modes: local (carrier-side evaluation with --radius), arango-http (live ArangoDB AQL mode). Supports --path-state-policy, --candidate-input for gradient ΔS. Used for physics-inspired semantic distance measurement.

nodes.title: scripts/leantrail_snapshot.py
nodes.description: CLI entry point for snapshot summary. Delegates to tools.leantrail.snapshot_summary.main().

nodes.title: scripts/leantrail_decl.py
nodes.description: CLI entry point for declaration lookup. Delegates to tools.leantrail.decl_lookup.main().

nodes.title: scripts/leantrail_dedup.py
nodes.description: CLI entry point for dedup candidates. Delegates to tools.leantrail.dedup_candidates.main().

nodes.title: artifacts/dag/index/decls.jsonl
nodes.description: One JSON object per declaration: {name, kind (theorem|def|axiom|opaque|inductive), module, file, line, column, doc, attrs (vacuity tags + rep_depth tags + capstone), typeFingerprint, valueFingerprint}. Produced by DAG/Indexer.lean. Consumed by leanTrail/normalizer.py.

nodes.title: artifacts/dag/index/edges.jsonl
nodes.description: One JSON object per dependency edge: {src, dst, kind: type|value}. Type edges come from ci.type constant collection; value edges come from ci.value? constant collection. Produced by DAG/Indexer.lean. Consumed by leanTrail/normalizer.py.

nodes.title: artifacts/dag/index/meta.json
nodes.description: Index metadata: {schemaVersion, timestamp, sourceHash, oleanHash, nodeCount, edgeCount, morphismCount, typeCount, nsFilter, importRoot}. Produced by DAG/Indexer.lean, stamped with ISO timestamp + olean hash by refresh_decl_graph.py. Used for incremental skip detection.

nodes.title: artifacts/dag/index/full_graph.json
nodes.description: Compact adjacency list: {nodes: [String], forward: [[(Nat, String)]]} — each entry is (target_index, edge_kind). Produced by DAG/Indexer.lean.

nodes.title: artifacts/dag/index/morphisms.jsonl
nodes.description: Category-theoretic morphisms recognized by the Indexer: {declName, category (Func|Hom|Equiv|Iso|Map), domainKey, codomainKey, typeStr, doc}. Produced by recognizeMorphism in DAG/Indexer.lean.

nodes.title: artifacts/dag/index/types.jsonl
nodes.description: Deduplicated type keys from morphism recognition: {key, display}. Produced by DAG/Indexer.lean.

nodes.title: artifacts/dag/index/edge-leakage.json
nodes.description: Leakage report: edges crossing namespace boundaries. {schemaVersion, nsFilter, totalEdges, keptEdges, droppedEdges, srcOutsideFilteredSet, dstOutsideModuleEdges, topExternalModules, topInternalModules, topExternalTargets, topInternalTargets, topUnknownTargets}. Produced by DAG/Indexer.lean.

nodes.title: artifacts/dag/representation-depth-tags.json
nodes.description: Per-declaration rep-depth data: {declarations: [{name, depth (count|projective|operator|krein|transport|thermo), depthNat (0-5), capstone (bool), layerLabel, layerDescription}]}. Produced by refresh_blueprint_tags.py from @[rep_depth] and @[capstone] attributes. Consumed by leanTrail/normalizer.py.

nodes.title: artifacts/dag/process-flow/process-events.jsonl
nodes.description: Process-flow events: per-declaration {node, role, boundaryClass, novelty, supportCandidates, comparisonCandidates, closureDeps}. Produced by DAG/ProcessFlowExport.lean. Consumed by leanTrail/normalizer.py to generate translator_of, coheres_with, obstructs edges.

nodes.title: artifacts/dag/process-flow/holonomy-events.jsonl
nodes.description: Holonomy telemetry events: {node, tactic_steps, context_expansion, metavariable_flux}. Produced by DAG/HolonomyExporter.lean. Consumed by leanTrail/normalizer.py to attach holonomy data to node attrs for hotspot scoring.

nodes.title: artifacts/leantrail/failed_transitions.jsonl
nodes.description: Failed transition records: {src, dst, kind, error_kind, count, total_cost, witnesses, id}. Produced by failure_harvester.py from process-flow defects. Consumed by normalizer.py (path_state = failed) and hole_packets.py (hole ranking).

nodes.title: artifacts/leantrail/path_locks.jsonl
nodes.description: Locked path records: {src, dst, kind, state (locked|bound), state-policy, proof-ref}. Produced by path_lock_registry.py. Consumed by normalizer.py (path_state = locked). Used by conformance.py for required-path-lock gate.

nodes.title: artifacts/leantrail/graph_snapshot.json
nodes.description: THE canonical GraphSnapshot — the primary data product consumed by all audit tools. Contains {metadata: {created_at, source, commit_sha, toolchain, artifact_version, scope, counts, path_state_sources}, nodes: [NodeRecord], edges: [EdgeRecord]}. Produced by leantrail/backend/indexer.py via normalizer.build_snapshot(). Consumed by GraphStore, vacuity_audit, hole_packets, surgery_plan, conformance, export, etc.

nodes.title: artifacts/leantrail/vacuity_audit.jsonl
nodes.description: Vacuity biopsy results: per-declaration {target, name, module, decl_kind, attrs: {vacuity: {role, is_prop, term_node_count, uses_external_gate, contains_vacuous_sockets, hit_unfold_limit, contains_sorry, unfolded_local_consts, suspicious_consts}, contamination: {state, violations, all_axioms, opaque_boundaries, closure_debts, hit_dependency_fuel_limit}}}. Produced by vacuity_audit.py running #biopsy_non_triviality.

nodes.title: artifacts/leantrail/hole_packets.jsonl
nodes.description: Ranked hole packets: per-hole {hole_id, src, dst, failure_count, total_cost, error_kinds, dependency_kinds, z2_surrogate, priority_score, socratic_packet, closure_contract, evidence, path_state, lock_requirement}. Produced by hole_packets.py.

nodes.title: artifacts/shadow_manifest.json
nodes.description: Shadow debt manifest: {generated, total_items, items: [{declaration, kind (sorryDebt|vacuityDebt|wrapperDebt|failedCompilation|...), domain, file, line, description, avoidance_count, last_attempt, status: open_debt}]}. Produced by shadow_index.py.

nodes.title: artifacts/leantrail/surgery_manifest.json
nodes.description: Surgery plan: proposed node removals, merges, and refactoring operations on the dependency graph. Produced by surgery_plan.py.

nodes.title: artifacts/leantrail/conformance_report.json
nodes.description: Cross-format conformance report: {baseline, candidate, node_drift_pct, edge_drift_pct, scc_signature_parity, path_query_parity, hotspot_jaccard, required_path_locks_check}. Produced by conformance.py.
